messages:
Max (Sales): Heads-up — HeliosBank just asked for a private deployment with VPC, HSM, and an air-gapped option. They want a Q3 pilot and have strong SLA asks. Can product triage?
Aisha (Product): Thanks Max. Can you paste the customer's primary success criteria and any non-negotiables? also cc legal if there's extra compliance.
Max (Sales): Quick paste from call: 
- pilot by 2026-07-15
- 99.9% inference uptime SLA during business hours
- HSM for key management, FIPS reqs
- no egress to public cloud (airgap preferred)
They said MVP can be single-model, not multi-tenant.
Emma (Support): Also noting they reported previous vendor had cold-start latency spikes at 200 concurrent QPS. They're sensitive to tail latency.
Jun (Eng): Important flags: air-gap + HSM + strict latency will likely push this into dedicated on-prem flavor. Need hardware spec: A100s vs H100s, NVMe caching for KV, and kernel support for our optimized ops.
Liam (Infra): Capacity check: dedicated pool required. We need estimated sustained RPS and token/sec. Also, air-gapped on-prem will require our private control plane package + on-site install window. Ops lead time ~6-8 weeks after order.
Aisha (Product): Proposed triage outcome options: (1) Backlog quick-win (low effort config) — not feasible here, (2) Dedicated project (cross-team: eng, infra, security) — likely, (3) Decline / refer partners if timeline impossible. We should map must-haves vs nice-to-haves.
Max (Sales): Must-haves = HSM, airgap, pilot timeline. Nice-to-haves = autoscaling, historical traces >90 days.
Jun (Eng): Tech constraints checklist (quick):
```
- model quantization path verified on target GPU
- KV cache size & NVMe swap behavior defined
- kernel compatibility for sequence length >= 2048
- integration test for HSM signing during inference
```
Aisha (Product): Launch criteria (minimum):
- private package deployed in air-gapped environment with our control plane disabled
- HSM integration validated with a test vector
- within SLA: p50 < 60ms, p99 < 500ms for stated load
- documented rollback and fallback to hosted-friendly model variant (customer permits)
Emma (Support): For backlog grooming: please add acceptance test steps and customer test harness. They'll run smoke tests during pilot week.
Liam (Infra): Dependencies to resolve: network peering plan, firewall/IP allowlist, on-prem infra checklist, STIG/KMS config, and install window with customer ops.
Aisha (Product): Next steps: 1) Sales to collect hardware spec (Max) 2) Support to capture test harness details (Emma) 3) Eng to estimate implementation effort (Jun) 4) Infra to validate install lead time (Liam). We'll reconvene tomorrow 10am.
Max (Sales): I'll get hardware spec and legal slack contact by EOD.
Emma (Support): I'll upload a sample smoke test and expected output logs to the shared drive.
Jun (Eng): I'll do a rough T-shirt estimate (S/M/L) for HSM + airgap work and post in thread by EOD.
Liam (Infra): I'll confirm install window and capacity delta. Tentative 6-8 week lead time noted.
deploy-bot: Ticket #PRIV-289 created for HeliosBank intake (assignee: Aisha). Scheduled triage call: 2026-05-05 10:00 UTC.
Aisha (Product): Great. If timeline can't meet Q3 pilot we need to negotiate scope: drop airgap pilot -> start VPC-only early, or reduce SLA during pilot. Please flag asap. :warning:
